efforge.description: The CLI version that printed this.

contract.description: The version of this contract. It changes only when a field is renamed, removed or changes meaning.

code.description: A stable identifier. Known codes: UnknownFlag, InvalidFlagValue, UnexpectedArgument, UnknownCommand, InsideProject, NeedsInput, UnknownValue, IncompatibleStack, InvalidProjectName, TargetNotEmpty, PnpmMissing, SetupIncomplete, Interrupted, WriteFailed, NotAnEfforgeProject, NoAddonIds, UnknownAddon, SlotAlreadySet, RemoveNotSupported, OverlayConflict, TransformAnchorMissing, CommandFailed, UpgradeNeedsCheck, InternalError. New codes can appear within a contract version; treat an unknown one like any failure.

fix.description: A command that does what you were trying to do, or null when there is none (then the other fields hold the facts, and `alternatives`, when present, the ways out to choose from).

error.description: More fields depend on `code`; see docs/json.md.
